_comment: Rigorous constants derived from Balaban's Renormalization Group Step. See Appendix derivations.

block_size_L.derivation: Standard Balaban block-spin choice. See app_thermodynamic_limit.tex, Sec. 2.

scaling_dimension_tail.derivation: Minimal scaling dimension for operators beyond D=14 truncation. Dependent on the Gauge Invariant Operator Spectrum (Glueball states).

eigenvalue_relevant.derivation: Explicit integration of the Haar measure using Interval Arithmetic (rg_map.cpp). Replaces proxy model.

primary_coupling_beta.derivation: Non-perturbative beta function envelope derived from large-N expansion and constructive bounds. Covers the 1-loop value but allows for O(g^5) corrections. Negative mass instability corrected.
primary_coupling_beta.note: Sign convention: beta is inverse coupling strength, positive.

mixing_tensor_bound.derivation: Upper bound on |T_ijk| for operator mixing. Derived from global geometric decay estimates (Random Random Walk rep) and Non-Perturbative Bootstrap (avoiding OPE).
mixing_tensor_bound.note: This is a UV quantity, independent of IR mass gap.

fluctuation_det_const.derivation: Vacuum energy contribution from log Det(Id + K). Bounded by ||K||_1 for small ||K||.

fluctuation_det_linear.derivation: Linear response of fluctuation determinant to background field. Computed from second variation of Wilson action.

tail_feeding_const_C.derivation: Bound on how low-frequency modes excite high-frequency tail. From Gevrey regularity of effective action at unit scale.
tail_feeding_const_C.note: CRITICAL: This constant depends ONLY on UV regularity, NOT on the mass gap. See RIGOR_VERIFICATION.md, Section 'Tail-Tracking Circularity'.

tail_contraction.derivation: lambda_tail = L^(4-Delta) * C_combinatoric. We use Delta_tail >= 6 based on Non-Perturbative Conformal Bootstrap bounds for irrelevant operators, strictly avoiding perturbative OPE circularity.
tail_contraction.reference: app_interval_arithmetic.tex, Theorem K.1. Note: Replaces perturbative OPE estimates.

verification_instructions: Run 'python interval_gap_check.py --audit' to verify these constants produce tube contraction.
